text: {"kind":"amendment","in_force_since":null,"reason":"Section 87DDD 1/2 already existed before 2025-08-01 (requiring a broker license for finding dwelling accommodations for a fee), and St. 2025, c. 9, § 43 amended it effective 2025-08-01 to add the contracting and fee-payment provisions, but the excerpts do not show when the earlier text first took effect."}
